title: Extracellular ATP Detection of Primary Cultured Microglia
author: Qiang Chen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.i9tch6n

steps.title: Reconstitute substrate solution
steps.instruction: Reconstitute the lyophilized substrate solution with the appropriate volume of buffer as specified by the manufacturer.

steps.title: Reconstitute ATP standard
steps.instruction: Reconstitute the lyophilized ATP standard vial with water to obtain the stock ATP standard solution.

steps.title: Prepare ATP dilution series
steps.instruction: Dilute the ATP stock to generate the following standard concentrations: 1000 pM, 500 pM, 250 pM, 125 pM, 62.5 pM, 31.2 pM, 15.6 pM, and 7.8 pM.

steps.title: Dispense samples and standards
steps.instruction: Using a 384‑well opaque plate, add 25 µL of each microglia sample or ATP standard to the designated wells.

steps.title: Add substrate to wells
steps.instruction: Add 25 µL of the reconstituted substrate solution to each well containing sample or standard.

steps.title: Shake plate
steps.instruction: Place the plate on a shaker and agitate for 2 minutes at 1,100 rpm.

steps.title: Measure luminescence
steps.instruction: Read the luminescence of each well with a PerkinElmer multifunctional microplate reader (USA).

steps.title: Calculate ATP content
steps.instruction: Generate a standard curve with CurveExpert V1.4 and calculate the ATP concentration of each sample from the luminescence values.
